parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9767 achieved with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.025, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. The trend of reducing MATRIX_LR while keeping the batch size low seems to continue yielding improvements. For the final round, I'll try adding WEIGHT_DECAY to see if regularization helps prevent overfitting at this lower LR.
parsed.description: Testing weight decay to see if regularization helps at the lowest tested learning rate (0.025).
